The '''ComTech Eavesdrop Protection Unit''' was a jammer pack designed to block all communications within a 150 meter radius. It was marketed as a way to ensure privacy, but it was usually used by [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] or criminals to disrupt communications and slow coordinated responses.
